msg: Look for colors that give you the most mushrooms, anything over 3 mushrooms. Stick with those colors until they give you between 1 or 2 mushrooms multiple times in a row. At which point, you can try switching to the opposing color and see if that yields better results. Receiving 0 or 3 mushrooms, even in a row, has no bearing on which color will typically harvest more mushrooms, so ignore those values.
